basis: Received-order superscriptions, word-events, vision questions, vocatives, addressee changes, sign command/performance/interpretation, date and scene resets, letter and scroll frames, prose-to-poetry transitions, nation headings and appendix framing. Canonical relations and WEB layout are evidence only.
proposal_bias: Prefer the larger complete oracle, poem, sermon, confession, sign-act sequence, prose scene, letter, scroll episode, nation oracle or appendix movement. Preserve exact macro parents and contested narrower alternatives.

chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split every imperative or derive a modern violence mandate.

chunks.form: creator/idol hymn, hammer judgment and messenger race
chunks.marker: Creator-by-power hymn opens; idol/portion contrast turns to hammer address and standard/kingdom summons, culminating in sequential messengers announcing captured crossings.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach creator hymn, identify the hammer beyond text, or reconstruct battle chronology.
chunks.risk: Identity, textual borrowing and historical reconstruction.
chunks.hold: Whole hymn-to-fall sequence retained with internal alternatives.

chunks.form: Zion plea, Babylon answer, escape calls and wall-fall finale
chunks.marker: Threshing-floor saying opens; Zion's devoured-me plea receives divine case/vengeance response, repeated flee/remember calls and broad destruction lament ending in burned gates.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not let later Babylon imagery dictate fulfillment or create one chunk per call/refrain.
chunks.risk: Later-reuse, formula over-split and violence ethics.

chunks.form: Seraiah scroll-to-Euphrates sign and collection colophon
chunks.marker: Fourth-year command frame opens; written Babylon words, read/pray/tie/throw performance and thus-Babylon-will-sink interpretation close with Jeremiah-words colophon.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach scroll act, relocate by chronology, or infer final authorship/redaction from colophon.
chunks.risk: Sign detachment, chronology and authorship strata.

chunks.form: historical appendix: reign, siege and royal capture
chunks.marker: Zedekiah accession formula opens; rebellion/siege/breach/flight lead to capture, judgment, blinding and Babylon imprisonment.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not make Kings a harmonized master text, repair ages/dates or select parallel wording.
chunks.risk: Kings harmonization, chronology and textual preference.
chunks.hold: Appendix received narrative chunked on its own terms.

chunks.form: historical appendix: destruction, temple inventory and executions
chunks.marker: Fifth-month captain arrival opens; burning/wall demolition, deportation, bronze-vessel inventory and named-prisoner execution culminate in exile statement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize inventory or harmonize object counts/names with Kings.

chunks.form: historical appendix: three-deportation register
chunks.marker: These-are-the-people register formula opens; three dated deportation totals close the list.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not reconcile totals, dates or deportations with Kings/Chronicles by changing seams.
chunks.hold: Register retained as its own list-function unit.

chunks.form: historical appendix: Jehoiachin release coda
chunks.marker: Thirty-seventh-year/new-king date reset opens; prison release, throne preference, changed garments and lifetime allowance close the book.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not let Kings parallel, royal genealogy or messianic reception dictate the coda seam.
chunks.risk: Parallel harmonization, chronology and messianic inference.
chunks.hold: Received hopeful/ambiguous coda retained; interpretation deferred.

premortem_holds.risk: Chapter fallback, one unit per word formula, detached sign interpretations, confessions psychologized as chronology and prose/poetry treated as redaction strata.
premortem_holds.appeal: Follow complete dialogues, lawsuit movements, laments and sign sequences; preserve macro parents and defer authorship/strata/chronology.

premortem_holds.risk: Repairing king names/dates from Kings, isolating branch or 29:11 prooftexts, and splitting yoke/scroll/letter responses from their frames.
premortem_holds.appeal: Use received Jeremiah scenes and exact form frames; relations and chronology remain evidence only.

premortem_holds.risk: Covenant, messianic, Israel/church or fulfillment systems dictate famous seams, especially 31:31-37 and MT-specific 33:14-26.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain complete restoration movements and LOW status; no witness, identity or theology choice.

premortem_holds.risk: Chronology/name repair, duplicate-release harmonization, sign detachment, political/ethical prooftexting and authorship inference from Baruch/scroll scenes.
premortem_holds.appeal: Chunk each received scene and sign on its own literary frame; preserve duplicate/chronology disputes append-only.

premortem_holds.risk: Importing LXX order, one chunk per place/formula, harmonizing other prophets, or letting Revelation determine Babylon seams and fulfillment.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain WEB/MT coverage order without preferring it; use nation headings and full macro parents, with textual order externally deferred.

premortem_holds.risk: Making 2 Kings a master text, repairing dates/counts/names, swallowing the deportation register or inferring messianic meaning from the final release.
premortem_holds.appeal: Chunk the appendix by its own narrative/list resets and preserve exact Kings relations as non-authorizing evidence.
